findings.title: Cancelled unscheduled reminders are still scheduled and sent
findings.body: The unscheduledReminders query filters on method=EMAIL, scheduled=false and scheduledDate<=now+72h but does not exclude cancelled=true. A BEFORE_EVENT reminder that was marked cancelled=true while still unscheduled (scheduled=false, referenceId=null) therefore remains eligible for scheduling in the same cron run and will be sent via SendGrid with a new batchId, defeating the cancellation for cancelled/rescheduled bookings.

findings.title: immediateDelete cancels SendGrid but leaks the DB row
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder with immediateDelete=true performs the POST /v3/user/scheduled_sends cancel and then returns without deleting or updating the WorkflowReminder row. Callers in handleNewBooking reschedule and workflows delete/update rely on this to remove the old reminder. The row stays scheduled=true with a now-cancelled batchId forever (until the past-date sweeper), leaving stale state and diverging from deleteScheduledSMSReminder which does delete the row.

findings.title: Cancellation sweeper missing method/scheduled/reference filters and aborts batch on error
findings.body: remindersToCancel selects any row with cancelled=true and scheduledDate<=now+1h, without restricting to method=EMAIL, scheduled=true, or referenceId NOT NULL. SMS/unscheduled rows would be sent to SendGrid with a null batch_id, and a single SendGrid failure throws out of the for-loop so remaining reminders are never cancelled and already-queued Prisma deletes after the loop are never awaited. Per-reminder error handling and precise filters are required.

findings.title: Async reminder cancellations fire-and-forget via forEach
findings.body: updatedBookings.forEach calls async deleteScheduledEmailReminder/deleteScheduledSMSReminder without awaiting or collecting promises, same pattern in handleNewBooking, bookings.tsx requestReschedule, and workflows.tsx. The handler can return and finish the request before the prisma update to cancelled=true or the Twilio/SendGrid cancel completes, so cancellations can be lost and rejections are unobserved. Use Promise.all over mapped promises.
